text:
Okay, so imagine it’s super late. Like, 3 a.m. late. The kind of time where the lights in the hospital hallway buzz like angry bees and smell all weird, like cleaning stuff mixed with old coffee.

There are two people sitting there on those squeaky plastic chairs. They don’t know each other at all. Not even a little bit. One guy has messy hair and looks like he hasn’t slept in days. He’s just staring at his shoes, tapping his foot really fast because he’s nervous.

Then, a nurse walks out from the double doors. She looks super serious. She says something quiet to the nervous guy. But here’s the secret part: she doesn’t say anything to the other person. That’s the thing! The other person is totally confused. They’re looking at their phone, pretending not to care, but you can tell they’re wondering what’s happening.

The first guy? He knows *everything*. Maybe someone got better, or maybe… well, maybe something bad happened. His eyes get wide and shiny, like when you’re trying not to cry at school. He stands up slowly, grabbing his jacket, and walks away without saying goodbye.

It’s kinda scary, right? Because the second stranger never finds out. They just sit there, alone, waiting for news that might never come. It makes me wonder what he’s thinking about while he watches the door close.
